# Lockpad

> A free, ad-free local notepad with a Samsung Notes–style lock on any note,
> no account and no in-app purchases. Write notes, lock the ones that matter
> behind a PIN (Web Crypto PBKDF2 + AES-GCM; body stored as ciphertext only),
> unlock through a modal with wrong-PIN backoff, optionally auto-lock on idle
> or when the tab is hidden. Search titles and tags (locked bodies are never
> decrypted). Tags and colours. Export / import JSON that carries locked
> notes as ciphertext + salt + KDF params, so a new browser restores them
> still locked. Works as an offline PWA on Android and any browser.

Notes and preferences stay in this browser on this device. There is no
account and no cloud sync. The JSON backup is the phone-loss answer, and it
never contains a locked note as plaintext.

## Features

- Multi-note list with create / rename / delete, editor with autosave
- Per-note lock with PIN or password (PBKDF2-SHA-256 ≥100k iterations, AES-GCM); locked note = `{ ciphertext, iv, salt, kdf }`, no plaintext body
- Unlock modal with wrong-PIN backoff (1s, 2s, 4s … capped)
- Optional auto-lock after idle time and / or when the tab is hidden
- Search on titles and tags; a locked note's body is never opened for search
- Optional tags and colours
- JSON export / import (`{ app: "lockpad", version: 1, notes, prefs }`) with locked blobs intact; import merges, never wipes
- No photo / voice attachments (so no attachment paywall); "delete all" only behind a typed confirm
- Local-only amber banner; ko / en / ja / zh via `?lang=`
- No login, no tool-UI ads, no subscription, no IAP
